titre: Capacité d'exportation de gaz liquéfié aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Bcf par jour, situation fin 2025 et projets engagés

En service.texte: As of December 2025, total operating U.S. LNG export capacity stood at 18 BCF/d, or 136.5 million metric tons per annum

En construction.texte: there is another 15 BCF/d (112.3 MTP/a) that is under construction scheduled to be commissioned between June 2026 and December 2031

Autorisée, non commencée.texte: there is an additional 13.3 BCF/d (101.3 MTP/a) of capacity that has received permitting but has not yet commenced construction
